# Scholar review register

Everything in Ar-Rayaan that needs a named scholar, clinician, native speaker, lawyer or rights holder before it can be called reviewed. Abdul's instruction (27 Oct 2026): do not exclude anything. Nothing has been reviewed by a named person yet, so every item below is **open** and every matching screen in the app says **Scholar review needed**.

Generated by `python3 tool/scholar_review/build_register.py` from the data files, the lesson and phrase flags, the audit and fix reports and `docs/OWNER_ACTIONS.md`. Do not edit by hand. The machine-readable copy is `tool/scholar_review/register.json` (fields: id, area, subarea, where_in_app, file, key, what_to_review, why_flagged, reviewer_type, also_reviewers, madhabs, priority, source_of_flag, label_surface, status).

## How a label goes away

When a named scholar agrees to be named, add one entry to `kScholarSignoffs` in `lib/app/core/scholar_review.dart` using the item id (or a parent id such as `huda.guide` for all guides) with the scholar's name and the date. The label for that item then reads "Reviewed by NAME on DATE". No name is invented. Nothing else changes.

Priority: **high** = a ruling, grade, school position, safety or rights question, or a point a report called out by name; **normal** = ordinary teaching text; **low** = a step the author labelled Interpretive or Reflection, or a mapping choice.

## Not covered by this register

- Anything added to the app after this register was generated: re-run the builder; a test fails if the Sources screen counts no longer match.
- Behaviour that is not content (device audio, notifications on a real phone): see `docs/OWNER_ACTIONS.md` item 8. Nothing in this task was tested on a device.
- Qur'an Arabic text is not "reviewed" here beyond the diacritics and edition items above; it is read from the bundled text, never typed.
